newsitem.title: HONG KONG: ONFEM, Oriental Met up after resumption.
newsitem.headline: ONFEM, Oriental Met up after resumption.

text.p: Shares of ONFEM Holdings Ltd and Oriental Metals (Holdings) Co Ltd rose steeply after trading in the shares resumed on Thursday morning.

Analysts said China Nonferrous Metals Holdings (Hong Kong) Ltd regained direct control of Oriental Metals, by buying a 40 percent stake in the company from its subsidiary ONFEM, would mean greater support for Oriental Metals.
Oriental Metals hit a record high of HK$1.80, up HK$0.16, before retreating to HK$1.73, up HK$0.09, in early trade.
ONFEM, which had proceeds of HK$354.5 million from the deal, added HK$0.175 to HK$4.325.
Trading in the both company's shares was suspended on Tuesday.
